Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU (Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control). European Commission, Joint Research Centre, EUR 40127, JRC140209. Targeted pass of a 764-page BREF (TOC, Ch.1.2.5 and 1.3.3 smithery energy, Ch.2.2.4 melting furnaces, 2.3.1 Tables 2.25-2.27, 2.3.8 energy consumption, Ch.3.1.3-3.1.4 and 3.2.1.3 energy techniques, 3.2.1.7.1 furnace selection costs, 3.2.2.1 cupola techniques, 3.2.4.1 NFM, 3.3.1 smitheries, Ch.4 BAT-AEPLs for energy, Ch.5 emerging). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 36). Main file: ferrous melting furnaces from Table 2.25 (EAF acid/basic, coreless induction steel/iron, cold blast, hot blast and long-campaign cupolas, oxy-fuel rotary) per t metal charge; aluminium furnaces from Table 2.26 (rotary, hearth, shaft, fuel/resistance/induction crucible, with the italic Eurofine 2002 row as separate processes); text values for EAF, coreless and channel induction, rotary, aluminium shaft, crucible and induction furnaces; Sect. 3.2.1.3.1 furnace comparisons; US EPA 2016 reverberatory measure series in kcal/kg (source unit kept); BAT-AEPLs (Tables 4.1-4.3, total heat plus electricity per t liquid metal, loaded with blank target = all carriers); forging stock heating (induction 400-500, gas-fired 1 200-2 500 kWh/t, Ade 2017) and three anonymised smithery heat-treatment plants (Table 1.3); costs (Busch induction conversion EUR 39 million / 42.2 t/h, Spanish 1997-98 cupola/rotary/induction comparison Table 3.33, twin cold blast cupola EUR 300 000 / 4.5 t/h, hot blast cupola Plant G DEM 26.4 million / 50 t/h, Reckers long-campaign cupola EUR 1.2 million / 12 t/h, AGA-Rayburn oxygas cupola operating costs Table 3.52); emerging hydrogen-reduction residue recycling and biocoke cupolas. Flows: cupola coke rates, Table 2.27 off-gas/holding energy, oxygas gas and oxygen, Plant G electricity export 75 kWh/t. Measures: quantified techniques of Ch.3. Other-values: primary efficiencies, residue rates, sector averages (Tables 2.101, 2.102, 3.5), smithery plant level, furnace counts, ambiguous Plant H investment. Not loaded: plant-level energy bar charts (Figures 1.24-1.31, 2.149-2.160; no printed numbers, CBI-anonymised), emissions (non-GHG), water, sand, noise, BAT-AELs. Many numbers are reprinted from older sources (CAEF 1997, ETSU 1992-1998, Vito 2001, TWG 2002, US EPA 2016); the reprint is named in each note.
